label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User-supplied parameter names flow through request.getParameterNames() into param, then to bar, and finally into obj which is written to the HTML response via out.format. No HTML encoding or sanitization occurs on bar before formatting. The X-XSS-Protection header is disabled ('0'), confirming the vulnerability is intentional.

evidence.note: User parameter names extracted into param variable from request.
param passed to doSomething and assigned to bar without modification.
bar included in obj array and written directly to HTML response via PrintWriter.format().
